newsitem.title: USA: Bion says converts $2.146 million in debt.
newsitem.headline: Bion says converts $2.146 million in debt.

text.p: Bion Environmental Technologies Inc said Friday it increased its stockholders' equity by $2.856 million in a deal that converted and cancelled $2.146 million of existing debt.
The company also said the deal added $710,000 of property to its balance sheet.
The company said the deal eliminates most of its ongoing debt service payments and provides assets that will be sold to provide a cash to fund its operations.
The company was not immediately able to provide further information.
